parts.label: Part 1
parts.article:
Hi. Can I help you?

Yeah. I saw on the internet that you have a film club here at the cinema, but there wasn't a lot about it. Can you tell me a bit more?

Yes. We're still setting up the web page. Sorry about that. We only started the club a few months ago. It's been very popular right from the beginning. We have regular film showings and there are lots of other benefits.

How often does the club meet?

Every two weeks, on Thursday nights.

OK. And I'm 16, so could I join?

Sure. People of any age can join.

Right. So how much does it cost to join?

Well it depends. The basic charge is £24 a season, but for people eligible for concessions it's £21.50.

I'm a student.

You'd get the concession rate then.

That's good.

That entitles you to free entry to the club films and also to £2 off tickets for all other films on at the cinema. So you'd pay £4.50 instead of £6.50.

Great.

OK. Now I don't know if this applies to you, but club members are also eligible for three hours complimentary parking when there's a film on.

I don't drive, but my girlfriend does, so it might be useful. Yes. OK. Well, I'd definitely like to join.

Can you give me any information about the next few films you’re showing?

I’m afraid we’ve run out of leaflets for this season, so I’ll tell you about the next few films and hopefully we’ll have all the details on the internet soon. So the next meetings this Thursday, October the 14th, and that’s a film called Pablo.

Oh, I read the reviews of that. It’s set in Argentina, isn’t it? About a child who’s run away from home?

That’s right. It just came out recently.

And the kid somehow gets on TV and he wins a dance competition or something.

A singing competition, yeah. I haven’t seen it either, but it tells you on the posters. Yes, it sounds really good.

Well, I definitely want to see that. What’s on after that?

On October the 28th, there’s an American film called The Soldier. That’s an old silent movie, but in this showing we have someone who will accompany it on the piano, just like they used to in the old cinemas, though it was sometimes an organ accompaniment in those days.

Must be a pretty old film then. When did they release the first talkies, 1926 or 27?

Yes, this was made in 1922, so well before, though I think they had short feature films with sound by 1923, actually.

So what sort of film is it?

Well, it’s billed as a comedy, they’d think it was a war film from the title. I don’t know much about the plot, we don’t have much information, but you could always look it up on the internet.

Yeah, I’ll do that. Then the next film after that, so that’ll be, let’s see, the 11th of November is a film about animals, and it’s just called Tiger. And that’s a cartoon film, which makes it sound as if it’s for children, but actually it’s aimed at adults and it’s really quite frightening in places. I saw it when it first came out.

What’s it about?

It’s got no humans in it at all. It’s just about the effect of environmental changes millions of years ago on the animals who lived then. It’s a really strange film. There’s a talk afterwards given by the directors, so that should be very popular. You’ll need to book early for that, I should think. / - Right. Well, thanks for all that....

analyses.content: 店员说任何年龄的人（People of any age）都可以加入，这就意味着没有 age（年龄） limit。
Student: OK. And I'm 16, so could I join? Employee: Sure. People of any age can join.
听到 "any age" 要能迅速反应出它对应的同义替换是 "no age limit"。
录音先说了基本费用是£24，接着说到有优惠资格的人是£21.50，随后你表明自己是学生（student），工作人员确认你可以享受优惠价，因此答案是21.50。
你可能会被最先听到的“£24”误导并忽略了整体语义，一定要注意听后面的转折词（but）以及对“学生”身份的具体报价确认。
Uh, so how much does it cost to join? Well, it depends. The basic charge is £24 a season, but for people eligible for concessions, it's £21.50. Oh, I'm a student. You'd get the concession rate then.
That entitles you to free entry to the club films and also to £2 off tickets for all other films on at the cinema. So you'd pay £4.50 instead of £6.50.
不要填 4.50（折后价）或者 6.50（原价），题目问的是 reduction（减免了多少钱）。
店员说票价可以减免（off）2 英镑，即 reduction 是 2 英镑。
OK. Now I don't know if this applies to you, but club members are also eligible for three hours complimentary parking when there's a film on.
需要听出 "complimentary" 就是题目中 "free" 的同义替换。
会员有资格获得三小时的免费（complimentary）parking（停车）。
Oh, I read the reviews of that. It’s set in Argentina, isn’t it? About a child who’s run away from home?
这是一个专有名词，听到地名要立刻反应过来，注意拼写 A-r-g-e-n-t-i-n-a。
学生确认这部电影的故事背景是不是设在（set in）Argentina（阿根廷），店员表示正确。
学生猜测是赢得舞蹈比赛，但店员立刻更正是 singing（唱歌） 比赛。
Student: And the kid somehow gets on TV and he wins a dance competition or something. Employee: A singing competition, yeah.
这是一个典型的“男猜测，女更正”的陷阱，不要听到第一个词 dance 就填，要听后面的确认信息。

That’s an old silent movie, but in this showing we have someone who will accompany it on the piano, just like they used to in the old cinemas, though it was sometimes an organ accompaniment in those days.
不要填 organ（管风琴），原文说那是过去旧时候（in those days）的做法，不是现在的安排。
这是一部无声电影，但放映时会有人在现场用 piano（钢琴） 进行伴奏。
Student: Must be a pretty old film then. When did they release the first talkies, 1926 or 27? Employee: Yes, this was made in 1922, so well before...
原文出现了一堆年份（1926, 1927, 1923）全是干扰项，只有 1922 是这部电影的制作年份。
店员明确回答这部电影制作于 1922 年。
Well, it’s billed as a comedy, they’d think it was a war film from the title.
小心 war film 这个干扰项，原文说 "they'd think it was a war film"，这是人们的误解。
虽然片名像战争片，但它实际上被归类为（billed as）一部 comedy（喜剧）。
There’s a talk afterwards given by the directors, so that should be very popular.
题目中的 "followed by" 对应原文的 "afterwards"，要抓取核心名词 talk。
电影结束后会有导演带来的 talk（讲座/谈话）。
